description.narrative: Tanger Med Port Authority (TMPA) is a Moroccan state-owned enterprise in charge of the management and development of the Tanger Med port located in the Strait of Gibraltar, with a current handling capacity of 9 million containers. The extension of the Tanger Med passenger and truck port will see the development of 12 berths and 86 ha of land. TMPA is seeking to increase its truck capacity to over 1 million units (the Project).

The most significant expected project-level outcome is driven by the positive effects on stakeholders through enhanced access to port services in Morocco via the increase in capacity at the Tanger Med passenger and truck port with catalyzed economywide effects. Beyond the Project, at the market level, this investment is expected to contribute to better integration and economic development in Morocco through greater connection to domestic and international markets. This will strengthen economic development of the Western Mediterranean region and contribute to maintaining Tanger Meds position as a global hub.
